en: Washington Longevity Healthy Life Club welcomes everyone who wants to pursue a healthier, longer life. We provide a place to connect, learn, take action, and grow alongside people who share that goal.
Let’s grow older together—happily and healthily.
To offer practical guidance for healthy daily living, create opportunities for wellness activities, and provide a trusted platform for longevity consultation and community support.
Eat with care, keep moving, and sleep well.
Turn useful benchmarks into action and healthy standards into daily life.
Keep exploring what a longer, fuller life can be.
Community expertise with an independent spirit.
The club is operated by a nonprofit company. It works cooperatively under the guidance of the chamber of commerce while maintaining relatively independent operations.
A light-asset membership service platform with project-based implementation and operations.
Eleven practitioners, researchers, educators, technologists, and community leaders contribute multidisciplinary perspectives to the club.
Select a profile to read the background supplied by the club. Professional biographies are presented for informational purposes and do not constitute an endorsement or medical advice.
Choose the way you want to take part.
The following rates and promotions were supplied by the club. Eligibility, availability, included services, and final payment details should be confirmed with a club coordinator before payment.
2026 renewal rate for eligible founding members
Includes a club-described wellness package valued at $800
Complimentary smart wellness watch for the first 20 pre-registered members.

Club materials describe tracking features for ECG, blood pressure, blood glucose, blood lipids, heart rate, uric acid, body fat, temperature, stress, sleep, exercise, and other wellness indicators, plus an AI voice assistant.

Important: Consumer wearables and their readings are not a substitute for professional medical evaluation, diagnosis, or treatment. Features, eligibility, availability, accuracy, and regulatory status should be confirmed with the club and device provider before use.
Questions before you join? Talk with the team.
cn: 华盛顿长寿康养俱乐部热忱欢迎所有希望追求长寿、渴望健康生活的朋友，为大家提供交流、学习、行动与共同成长的平台。
让我们一起快乐健康地慢慢变老！
提供吃喝玩乐的健康指导、参与康养活动的机会，以及长寿咨询与社区服务平台。
持续探索长生不老的美好愿景
汇聚专业力量，保持独立活力。
俱乐部由非盈利性公司运营，与商会是商会指导下的合作关系，同时保持相对独立运营。
轻资产运营，以会员服务平台为基础，通过项目管理实施运作。
十一位来自中医、医学、肿瘤研究、生物物理、营养健康、科技与社区服务等领域的专家和实践者，共同为俱乐部提供多学科视角。
认识我们的专家与顾问。
